programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Roger takes Camila to a building under construction, alone, under duress he makes her talk to Ezequiel, who threatens Roger to kill him if he harms Camila. programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Camila approaches him trying to calm him down and the commando takes advantage of the situation to subdue the young man. Camila runs to take refuge in Max's arms.
